detail.goal: look up member 12345 and read their current savings balance

detail.why: The Member ID textbox is the input for the member lookup; typing the target member number here parameterizes the search for replay.

detail.target: button named "Search" follows "Search Type" in frame "main"
detail.why: Submits the Member Inquiry form to retrieve the member record for the entered Member ID.

This is the balance cell in the row labelled "Savings" of the Account/Balance table — the requested current savings balance. Anchoring to the "Savings" row label makes it re-findable even if amounts or row order change.
Captures the member name beside the "Name" label to confirm on replay that the balance belongs to the intended member record.
Records the Member ID shown on the detail screen so replay can verify the loaded record matches the searched input.

detail.summary: Searched Member ID 12345 with Search Type "Member Number" and landed on the Member Detail screen for Sarah Chen (Active). Current savings balance is $4,182.55 (checking, for reference, is $1,204.10). Recorded outputs: savingsBalance, memberName, memberId — each located by its row label so they can be re-found on replay.
